question.text: Under RBI's Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS), an Indian resident individual can remit overseas up to what amount per financial year?

explanation.text: The Logic: The LRS limit for a resident individual is USD 250,000 per financial year. The Trap: Lower USD figures generally reflect older caps and the USD 1 million figure is unrelated to the LRS resident-individual limit. Note: The USD 250,000 LRS limit is the source-backed figure.
